# DPPCompliance.com

> DPPCompliance.com — neutral, C-suite-readable banner for the Digital Product Passport (DPP) under the ESPR — data models, identifiers (QR/UID), lifecycle traceability, attestations & auditability, PLM/ERP/PIM/MDM integrations. Serious offers only (companies & institutions).

Note: premium digital asset. Descriptive use. No official affiliation. No legal, financial, medical, regulatory or investment advice. Descriptive digital asset only: no service, no platform, no certification. Domain name only is transferred. No software, datasets, services or staff included.
